|errata_history=Versions of [[Civil Disorder (V)]] in [[Virtual Set 6: City In The Clouds]], in date order (3 versions). Slip texts are quoted as printed: ▼ and ▲ are the slips' arrow icons (deploy from / take into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle), and the immunity and pilot icons are the ones explained in each sheet's icon key (see [[Virtual card icons]]). Found while adding the original pre-Remaster slips (Bill, 12 November 2026).
* '''Original''' ([[Civil Disorder (V) (Virtual Set 6)]]): the Committee's interim rules supplement “Star Wars CCG Changes to Virtual Set #6” (“Updated 31 Dec 2003”; PDF dated 31 December 2003; [https://web.archive.org/web/20040615005231/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/Resources/v6changes.pdf v6changes.pdf on swccgpc.com], Internet Archive capture of 15 June 2004), Section 1. Updated Light Side Texts: “Deploy on table. You may not play Rebel Barrier. Whenever you initiate a battle, you may activate 1 Force and/or take the topmost character (without a permanent weapon or a maintenance cost) from your Lost Pile into hand. Senators are deploy +2. May lose 1 Force to cause a combat card to be lost. (Immune to Alter)” The supplement is “an official rules document” giving “interim updated card text”; it prints the text only (no slip, stats or lore), says the texts “are not final and may differ from the texts provided in the final version of Virtual Set #6”, and spells the immunity out as “(Immune to Alter)” (no icon). Stats and lore on this page are those of the January 2004 slip. This is the earliest surviving text: the first release sheet of 21 November 2003 is not preserved. Image: the card's entry cut from the supplement ([[:File:OVS6-06-Civil_Disorder-interim-text-2003-12-31.png]]).
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Civil Disorder (V) (Virtual Set 6) (Errata)]]): the “Final Revised Virtual Set 6” sheet “Virtual Set #6” (Players Committee; announced and tournament-legal 12 January 2004; PDF dated 12 January 2004), page 1, slip 6 — [https://web.archive.org/web/20040619231451/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/Resources/AbsolutelyFinalVersion6.pdf AbsolutelyFinalVersion6.pdf on swccgpc.com] (Internet Archive capture of 19 June 2004; the Committee still hosts the same file as [https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualCards6.pdf VirtualCards6.pdf] on res.starwarsccg.org), announced on the [https://web.archive.org/web/20040415220046/http://swccgpc.com/interior.htm Committee's news page]: “Deploy on table. You may not play Rebel Barrier. Whenever you initiate a battle, you may activate 1 Force and/or take the topmost character (without a permanent weapon or a maintenance cost) from your Lost Pile into hand. Senators are deploy +2. May lose 1 Force to cause a combat card to be lost. A” The first release sheet of 21 November 2003 is not preserved. The slip is the old pre-template slip the Committee used before its December 2006 Remaster: the Decipher-style lower half with the slip mark “6•6” at bottom right and no expansion icon. The updated sheet of 12 October 2004 ([https://web.archive.org/web/20050406053829/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/Resources/Virtual%20Set%206.pdf Virtual Set 6.pdf], Internet Archive 6 April 2005; PDF dated 12 October 2004) prints the same words on the same old slip ([[:File:OVS6-06-Civil_Disorder-original-slip-2004-10-12.png]]). '''What changed''' (from the 31 December 2003 interim text): the immunity is the sheet's immunity icon instead of “(Immune to Alter)” in words, and the text ends with it (“… to be lost. [Immune to Alter icon]”).
* '''PC-E2''' (this page): the Remaster sheet (official text as of 4 December 2006; [https://web.archive.org/web/20071024154341/http://www.swccgpc.com/Resources/VirtualCards6.pdf Internet Archive capture of 24 October 2007], slip 6), in the Committee's Remaster template: “Deploy on table. You may not play Rebel Barrier. Senators are deploy +2. Whenever you initiate a battle, may retrieve your topmost non-[[Permanent Weapon]], non-[Maintenance] character. May place the top card of your Reserve Deck in Lost Pile to place a combat card in owner’s Lost Pile. (Immune to Alter.)” '''What changed:''' the Remaster rewrote the slip in the Committee's later wording (full text above; icons written out in words here). This is the current text of the Virtual Original card.
